description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2102/48 of 21.12.2018, Meerigama D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to parcel numbers, land extents, ownership details, and encumbrances for various land plots across different districts. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, specifically title registration amendments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
